profile.headline: DevOps Engineer at Travel & Leisure Co
profile.summary:
With over seven years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, I specialize in developing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and scalability. At Capital One, I contributed to a multiplatform IDE plugin that reduced technical overhead and saved over 10,000 hours of manual labor monthly, benefiting thousands of users. My work integrates cutting-edge technologies, including generative AI, to streamline problem-solving and improve enterprise performance.  

I am dedicated to fostering collaboration and empowering teams through mentorship and ownership of impactful projects. By aligning with stakeholders and prioritizing high-value features, I have driven a 20%+ increase in CI/CD pipeline efficiency. My AWS certifications reflect my commitment to leveraging cloud technologies to deliver robust and scalable solutions.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a multiplatform IDE plugin to reduce technical overhead and promote adherence to testing standards.
- Successfully adopted by thousands of users, yielding a reduction of 10,000+ hours in manual labor per month
- Integrated a prompt engineering solution utilizing generative AI to facilitate dynamic problem-solving for end-users.
- Aligned with multiple stakeholders (product managers, project managers, architects) to develop a strategic roadmap that prioritizes high impact features with measurable results
- Empowered engineers through mentorship and feature ownership to cultivate technical capability and career growth
Increased efficiency of the enterprise CI/CD pipeline by 20%+
- Turned the abstract ask into multiple forward-thinking solutions to exceed the expected goal
- Decreased time to market for all projects across the company while improving developer satisfaction
- Utilized data driven approach to obtain directional buy-in from senior technical leadership
Developed an Infrastructure as Code solution to empower developers to deploy Relational Databases to AWS
- Designed and Implemented multi-region deployment pattern to ensure high availability for critical applications
- Provided simplified onboarding solutions for highly customized databases
- Modernize the deployment and maintenance process for 30%+ of legacy databases to reduce manual maintenance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪​ Eliminated 10K+ hours of manual labor monthly by developing a multiplatform IDE plugin adopted by thousands of users, standardizing testing practices and reducing technical overhead across engineering teams.
▪​ Increased enterprise CI/CD pipeline efficiency by 20%+ by designing and implementing scalable solutions that streamlined workflows and improved deployment consistency across environments.
▪​ Modernized 30%+ of legacy databases by developing Infrastructure as Code solutions for AWS, reducing manual maintenance and enabling consistent, scalable database deployment.
▪​ Decreased time to market across company projects by integrating generative AI prompt engineering solutions, enhancing workflow automation and improving developer satisfaction.
▪​ Secured senior technical leadership buy-in for strategic initiatives by leveraging data-driven insights, translating ambiguous challenges into forward-thinking solutions aligned with business and engineering priorities.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Automated CI/CD Pipeline
 - Fetching of Packages
 - Compilation of Code

Azure Resource Management
